title: Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
body:
Dua Dengi Tumhe Zahra Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
hai Lene Ko Yaha Pursa Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
01. Saliqa Majlis E Shah Ka
ata E Zainab E Kubra
hai Momin Ke Liye Tohfa Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
02. Kabhi Bhulo Na Is Gham Ko
uthao Haath Maatam Ko
karam Abbas Ka Hoga Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
03.alam Yu Hee Uthao Tum
yuhi Aansu Bahaao Tum
bahaao Tum Lahu Apna Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
04.kiya Wo Zulm Aada Ne
kate Abbas Ke Shaane
wo Saqqa E Sakina Tha Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
05. Wo Farwa Ka Dulara Tha
badan Tukde Hua Jiska
ho Matam Uski Shaadi Ka Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
06. Tha Laila Ka Jawaan Beta
wo Hamshakle Payambar Tha
laga Tha Qalb Me Naiza Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
07.wo Kamsin Tashnalab Asghar
laga Tha Teer Gardan Par
hai Jhula Khali Ab Uska Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
08. Gharane Par Muhammad Ke
huwe Haaye Sitam Kaise
luta Ek Din Me Ghar Saara Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
09. Badi Nemat Mili Hamko
badi Izzat Mili Hamko
ye Sab Ehsaan Hai Uska Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Rasheed Ab Waaris E Gham Ko
adab Se Pesh E Pursa Ho
yahi Hai Apna Nazrana Karo Matam Shaheedo Ka
